notes.content:
Hello again!

We are doing big progresses with the game, currently working on:

-Improving our graphical targets.
-Writing everything from zero with a lot of attention to the optimization.

notes.title: Easy Red 2: Development log
notes.content:
Good morning.
Here is some information on the development status of Easy Red 2.

[list]
[*] It will probably take place in 2 big maps: Anzio coast and Tarawa. If this is confirmed, there will be at least a landing mission in both maps. New interesting maps could anyway be added as DLC (Something like grece could be very interesting).
[*] It will have a very advanced mission editor compared to Easy Red 1.
[*] There will be many new mechanics including squad management.
[*] Graphics and animations will be totally revised.
[*] It will take about 8 months of work, or maybe more.
[/list]

[i]Keep up with feedbacks about stuff you want to see in the next Easy Red![/i]

here's a little graphical concept image:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31201701/b2b079cbeb2b505f775a34e2c1081d2e76d43bee.png[/img]

Marco.

notes.title: EASY RED 2 - Development Topic
notes.content:
Hello to everyone!

I am happy to announce that [b]a new version of Easy Red is in development.[/b]
Next version will be released at least on PC and Nintendo Switch - keep this in mind for considerations about hardware limitations when you post your ideas.
Easy Red focus his mechanics around a realistic battles simulations offline (and maybe, next title online too? how?) where soldiers tries to react in a realistic way to combat scenarios, where player can have a solid management of every bullet in his inventory, and where weapon management try to be as accurate as possible.
All of this in big battles where you can be every single soldier on the battlefield experiencing how the key to survive is actually fighting with caution and strategies.
[b]
We want to keep the exact same ideas and bring them to the next level.[/b]

We have a lot of new ideas for next re-made from scratch title, for example:
[list]
[*]A new improved First Person view and animations management.
[*]New modern details such as foot placement on the ground, and responsive animations.
[*]Totally new and more realistic management of the troops, adding a squad-based system where an officer will give orders to infantry inside a squad to coordinate fights. Player will of course be able to play as soldier that must follows orders and squad commander as well.
[*]Improvements in graphics and optimizations to be able to handle many more units in a fight.
[*]Adding of new soundtracks to make the fights even more intensive.
[/list]

We will enlarge this list with your suggestions!

Also we need to decide where this will take place. We will consider everything, from totally historical accurate campaigns to more story-based scenarios.

Hoping we gave you an exciting announcement, we are curious to read your ideas!
[i]
Marco[/i]

Help us during the early development decision of the games filling this super quick form:
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScqq2gDliSp6OXJUDoYGPRXppnVXQ7DpEb_859S_-pomcr5Fw/viewform?usp=sf_link

notes.title: Fixing update + Easy Red 2 News
notes.content:
[i]Hello from Corvostudio.[/i]

We are starting releasing a new series of fixes for Easy Red.

From this build the game should be much more stable.

Anyway you can test the beta version on game properties on steam library.

Also we are starting working on [b]Easy Red 2[/b].

I'm not sure about when the work will start, but I hope by the end of April.

Easy Red 2 will bring many news such as:

[list]
[*] Every graphical improvements that A Front Too Far had. (Look here:) https://store.steampowered.com/app/958320/A_Front_Too_Far_Normandy/
[*]A new map with new missions.
[*]Many new models and weapons. Most of the models will be replaced.
[*]Totally new and fresh animations.
[*]Totally new FX and sounds.
[*]Huge optimizations.
[/list]

I'm not sure yet where the game will placed.
I was wondering about Battle of the bulge (but snow could be boring after some times) or Operation Market Garden.
I was also considering WW1.

Please leave suggestions about this in this thread.

Thank you


[i]Marco.[/i]

notes.title: UPDATE - VERSION 1.0 RELEASED
notes.content:
Here's the changelogs:

Fixed inventory bugs.
Fixed bouncing destroyed vehicles.
Fixed Horsa Glider size and collisions.
Fixed Pointe du Hoc Day 2 mission.
Fixed game saves bug.*
Fixed joypad detected error that makes walk right.
Fixed water.
Improved quality and performance.
Improved and fixed inventory.
Improved third person on small vehicles.
Improved Omaha Beach mission.
General mission editing and fixes.
Map updated.
New achievements.
New mission: Saint Jores.
Added Mission Editor.
Added KubelWagen.
Added Sdkfz251
Added static Mg42 and 30Cal
Added German, Dutch and French translations.

*Did you get a startup freeze from last update? here's the fix:
Go to installed game folder and start FIX BROKEN SAVE.bat
Don't start it if you never had problems of startup freezing.

With this update, the game is at version 1.0
This dosn't means that Easy Red will not updated anymore. If there will be something to fix or improve i'll do it.
I'll take some time to go ahead with my studies, and then maybe i'll start working on a free DLC (I don't know what it will and when i'll start working on it).

What about multiplayer?
When i started working on this game, multiplayer wasn't planned. As i wrote some times ago, it would be out as free DLC. I tried to implement it, but when i started writing the code, i didn't make it multiplayer-oriented, and i built the game on that code. So basically i should write all the code again.
I will try anyway, but i can't confirm that multiplayer will ever on the game.

So, here's what came out with this.
Easy Red contains 3 years of work.
More then 3500 hours in front of a PC and about 70.000 lines of code.
I did my best with it, and i'm happy about what i did.
I would like to say thank you to all voice actors and translators that helped me, to all people that gave me feedback and suggestions, and to all players, that played and enjoyed the game giving it a reason to exist.

Marco.
